<thought>To build the required retrosynthesis route, I first retrieved the SMARTS for each of the five specified templates (29646, 1914389, 1914390, 149040, 1914391) using the get_template tool. This lets me see how each template transforms a molecule in the retro direction. I then verified that each template can be applied to the intermediate generated by the previous step using check_smiles_reaction_template_matching. After confirming applicability, I applied each template with apply_template to obtain the precursor(s) for that step. The resulting precursors were chained together to form a five‑step route that respects the required order of templates. Finally, I assembled the route into the JSON format requested, with the target molecule at the root and each reaction node containing the appropriate template_id and its precursor molecules.</thought>
